name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 24, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Senior Pastor Matthew Palm, Hope Church of the Nazarene
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamations to Vista Sheriff’s Deputies in recognition of receiving an award from the California Highway Patrol for the number/value of stolen cars recovered. (CC)
P2.
Proclamation declaring July 2, 2008, "Marine Light Attack Helicopter Squadron 369 Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P3.
Proclamation declaring June 24, 2008, "Jim Baumann Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P4.
Presentation of Certificates of Appointment to Incoming and Certificates of Appreciation to Outgoing Commissioners, Board and Committee Members. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Special Event Banner Program for 2008 Calendar Year (CC)
C5.
Unscheduled Vacancies on the Public Arts Commission and Project Area Committee (CC)
1.
Confirm Carol Landis as the Mayor's appointment to fill the unscheduled Rancho Buena Vista Adobe representative vacancy on the Public Arts Commission for a term ending June 30, 2011; and
2.
Confirm David Nilson as the Mayor's appointment to fill the unscheduled Vista Chamber of Commerce representative vacancy on the Redevelopment Project Area Committee for a term ending June 30, 2011.
C6.
Alcohol Beverage Control Licenses (CC)
1.
Protest all new ABC license applications received prior to the August 12, 2008, City Council meeting; and
2.
Withdraw the protests once the City's standard conditions are agreed upon by the applicant.
C7.
Wayfinding Program Design Concepts (CC)
C8.
Traffic Engineering Consultant Amendment No. 3 (CC)
C9.
As-Needed Dry Weather Monitoring Agreement (CC)
C10.
As-Needed Engineering Survey Services Agreements (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an agreement with Gold Coast Surveying, Inc.; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an agreement with Melchior Land Surveying, Inc.
C11.
Adoption of 2008-2009 Appropriation Limit (CC)
C12.
Memorandum of Agreement with San Diego County for AlertSanDiego (CC)
C13.
Fiscal Year 2007 Safer Grant (CC)
C14.
California Children's Outdoor Bill of Rights (CC)
C15.
2007-2008 Citywide Slurry Seal Project Notice of Completion (CC)
C16.
Home Ownership Program (CDC)
1.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Vista Home Ownership Program;
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , finding that the use of Low and Moderate Income Housing funds outside the Redevelopment Project Area for the Vista Home Ownership Program will be of benefit to the Vista Redevelopment Project; and
3.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , amending the operating budget for Fiscal Year 2007-2008.
C17.
Targeted Site Investigation Services (CDC)
C18.
Civic Center Structural Steel Procurement (CC)
C19.
Urban Futures Consultant Services Agreement (CDC)
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Candidate Statement Regulations for November 2008 Election (CC)
1.
Establish the maximum number of words, 200 or 400, to be permitted in a candidate's statement of qualifications for the office of Member of the City Council at the November 4, 2008, General Municipal Election; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , adopting regulations for candidate's statements to be submitted to the voters.
D2.
Moonlight Amphitheatre Stage House Design/Build Services (CC)
D3.
Fiscal Year 2008-2009 Operating Budget Mid-Term Revision (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following, approving amendments for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 of the two-year 2007-2009 City budget, approving additional appropriations, and authorizing the City Manager/Executive Director to make certain adjustments:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- ;
b.
Buena Sanitation District Board Resolution No. 2008- ; and
c.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- .
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , finding and determining that the planning and general administrative expenses chargeable to the low and moderate income fund for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 are necessary for the production, improvement or preservation of low and moderate-income housing; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the City-Wide Classification and Compensation Index and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Levy of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges for FY 2007-2008 (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2008-2009 property tax roll for delinquent refuse collection service fees and collection charges.
PH2.
Collection of Delinquent 2007 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to provide an opportunity for each owner of land or other interested person whose parcel is affected by the Report of Proceedings and an Account of Costs Incurred to present a written or oral protest or objection to such report and account; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving and confirming a report and account for abatement of weeds, shrubs, dead trees and waste matter for Fiscal Year 2006-2007.
PH3.
Collection of Delinquent Sewer Service Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , memorializing the sewer service charge for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2008-4 and approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2008-2009 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , memorializing the sewer service charge for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008-1 and approving liens on assessor's parcels within the district to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2008-2009 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges.
PH4.
Levy of Assessments for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the City of Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2008-2009;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2008-2009; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the South Melrose Drive Landscape Maintenance District for Fiscal Year 2008-2009.
PH5.
Sonic Lease Agreement and Related Transactions (CC/CDC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008 - , approving a Lease Agreement between the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista and D & M Investment Partners, Inc., for the development of a Sonic Drive-in Restaurant;
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008 - , approving a Purchase and Sale Agreement with the Licup Family Trust to acquire property located at Broadway and South Santa Fe Avenue;
3.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008 - , approving a Purchase and Sale Agreement with Arnoldo and Irma C. Vargas to acquire property located at Main Street and South Santa Fe Avenue; and
4.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008 - , approving a Lease Agreement with D & M Investment Partners, Inc. for the development of a Sonic Drive-in Restaurant.
PH6.
Vista Village Plaza, 964 Vista Village, LLC, applicant (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony and adopt the following:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Mitigated Negative Declaration for a Specific Plan Amendment, Special Use Permit, Site Development Plan, Tentative Subdivision Map and a Comprehensive Sign Program to construct a four-level 83,276 square foot mixed-use building containing retail and office spaces, townhouses, and integrated parking structures, landscaping, and associated improvements on a 0.78 acre site at 964 Vista Village Drive; and
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Special Use Permit, Site Development Plan, Tentative Subdivision Map and Comprehensive Sign Program to construct a four-level 83,276 square foot mixed-use building containing retail and office spaces, townhouses, and integrated parking structures, landscaping, and associated improvements on a 0.78 acre site at 964 Vista Village Drive.
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled: "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending the Specific Plan No. 26 (Downtown Vista) to Reduce the Required Building Setback Along the Northerly Side of Vista Village Drive, Between N. Citrus Avenue and Hillside Terrace/ Escondido Avenue, from 20 Feet to 3.5 Feet Measured from the Ultimate Street Right of Way Line."
PH7.
Downtown Mixed Use Project Disposition and Development Agreement (CC/CDC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Purchase and Sale Agreement, a Redevelopment Loan Agreement, Loan No. 2008-01, and the conveyance of property to the Community Development Commission;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the conveyance of property to the Community Development Commission for the purposes of correcting title;
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Disposition and Development Agreement with G8 Development, Inc., for the development of the Downtown Mixed Use Redevelopment Project;
4.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Purchase and Sale Agreement, a Redevelopment Loan Agreement, Loan No. 2008-01, and the receipt of property from the City of Vista;
5.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , approving the receipt of property from the City of Vista; and
6.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Disposition and Development Agreement with G8 Development, Inc., for the development of the Downtown Mixed Use Redevelopment Project.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
